source.test: NeoForgeInstaller.install(into:javaPath:onLog:) -- args file guard after a successful exit

notes: Same ordering as ForgeInstaller: `guard let argsRel = findArgsFile(...) else { throw NeoForgeError.argsFileMissing }` (line 126) runs after the exit-code guard but before both cleanup lines (130-131), so a 0-exit install that didn't produce `unix_args.txt` still fails and leaves both `neoforge-installer.jar` and `installer.log` behind. The real corpus (`neoforge/installer-evidence/unix_args.txt`, captured P7.3) proves this file is produced by a genuine 20.4.237 install; this fixture is the counterfactual where it isn't.
